library.about: Production art for the 2D golden run's Tower Merge Rush, in the design's riso-arcade identity kit. Mapped by requirement id for the drop-merge archetype's ids, and by role for any other id the design gives the same role. Every SVG is written by tools/make_art.py (authored for web-game-template, CC0-1.0). The fonts are subset WOFF2 builds (Latin + Cyrillic) of OFL-1.1 Google Fonts families - Rubik Mono One and Manrope, the riso-arcade kit's faces for a title with ru in scope; their licences are fonts/*-OFL.txt. The music and sound effects (audio/) are composed as code (tools/audio-score.js) and rendered by examples/wgf-golden-shared/library/tools/audio/render.mjs, CC0-1.0; where a cue layers a recording it is a CC0-1.0 Kenney sample kept beside it in audio/sources/ with its licence. audio/render-report.json holds each file's measured duration, RMS, peak and loop seam.
